design: Retrospective sensitivity of E7 attribution after the original midpoint allocation and 1669 sign reversals were known. Defined before E16 calculation.
contexts: Match municipality, year and original class code. Retained contexts get both-factor attribution. Added or withdrawn contexts enter as whole stock contributions, with no factor attribution.
target: Effect of the source revision on the 2020 to 2021 municipality stock difference. Subtract the 2020 contributions from the 2021 contributions.
dominance_rule: Absolute soil contribution exceeds sum of absolute area, added-context and withdrawn-context contributions, as in E7.
checks: Closure for each municipality-year and annual-difference target under each convention
Reproduce 1669 sign reversals and midpoint dominance count from E7
Independent source CSV parser and math.fsum for final target contributions
limits: Allocation order is an accounting convention, not a physical cause
No new prediction or emissions inventory
The same extracted maps are reused
No probability sample or causal identification
